text:
noah (sales): ClinicTech asked for a short POC: verify sustained 200 r/s for ~64-token outputs, p95 <300ms, plus cold-start behavior. They want to run in their air-gapped site; can we support a self-run harness?

maria (solutions): Yes. Two options: a) ephemeral Dedicated in their VNet for controlled baseline, then mirror to on-prem; b) provide offline package + k6 harness for them to run. Recommend (a) for first pass.

devon (eng-ml): k6 snippet prepared (constant-arrival-rate at 200/s). Warmup 3m at 25%, then steady 12m blocks. Capture JSON summary. Use --out json=summary.json.

akash (eng-runtime): Runtime config: redwood-13b, int8 quantize, prefix_cache true, max_batch_size 64, batch_timeout_ms 6, concurrency_per_gpu 4. Hardware: 2 nodes x 4 GPUs.

sophia (security): For on-prem: offline control plane supported, customer KMS/HSM OK, audit logs local, SOC2 under NDA. Will provide one-page security appendix.

noah (sales): Pricing ask: give simple POC rental + managed support fee and token-cost illustration for 12h steady run.

maria (solutions): I'll draft runbook + CSV schema: run_id, node_id, timestamp, req_id, status, latency_ms, tokens_out, batch_size, cpu%, gpu%.

akash (eng-runtime): Cold-start test: restart single node and probe 10 sequential requests, record first-request latencies. Repeat per node. I'll run baseline this afternoon and post numbers.

deploy-bot: ephemeral-dedicated-clinic-17691: pool created (2 nodes, 4 gpus/node). status: provisioning

noah (sales): Thanks all — Maria to send runbook + template; Akash to attach baseline; Sophia to add sec appendix; Devon to attach k6 scripts. I'll package and send to ClinicTech. :thumbsup:
